correctness.rationale: For each integer n=3..12, C++17 BFS and independent Python Floyd-Warshall construct 4n vertices and 6n distinct edges, exhaust every 2-,3-,4-element vertex subset, and apply exact edge-signature injectivity. Every output coefficient agrees; all quadruple counts positive, all pair counts zero, triple count 160 only at n=10. A third independent n=10 automorphism enumeration yields six disjoint orbits covering those 160 triples. Exhaustive bounded loops prove the finite claim; the all-n corollary cites precisely Theorem 1 of Iqbal et al. with published n>=13 scope. No finite trial was extended to an infinite inference.
